title: Persona 4
synopsis: Atlus’s Persona 4 on PlayStation 2 — the North American retail disc that fixed the Inaba mystery on optical media for this shelf.

catalog.mediumForm: Pressed optical disc · PlayStation 2 retail edition

custody.physical: Complete in box: case, pressed disc, manual, and original cover insert
custody.condition: Complete in box. Light shelf wear consistent with age. Preserved as a playable reference copy.

curatorNotes:
Persona 4 is the PlayStation 2 chapter that carried the series into a small-town murder mystery and a yellow that later became inseparable from the franchise’s identity. The North American retail packaging used the full Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4 title; this filing keeps the common name on the spine while recording the official NA branding in the catalog record.

The shelf retains SLUS-21782 because that is the edition Atlus shipped for NTSC-U consoles in December 2008, months after the Japanese July release. Later Vita and remaster editions rewrite presentation and platform; they do not replace the pressed PS2 object as evidence of how the game first circulated in this region.

This filing sits with Persona 3 Reload as lineage on the shelf — different hardware generations, the same series authority — without collapsing the two into a single story.
collectionNotes:
Acquired in August 2026 while expanding the PlayStation 2 physical shelf.

The retained copy is the North American PlayStation 2 edition published by Atlus (SLUS-21782), issued under the full packaging title Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4. North American retail packaging commonly included a bonus Original Soundtrack CD with the game disc; both media, where present, remain housed with the copy. The set remains complete in box with manual and cover insert, and is kept as the reference copy for this filing.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Sony PlayStation 2; compatible North American PlayStation hardware
preservation.compatibility: Pressed for North American PlayStation 2 consoles. The retained game disc remains the primary access copy.
preservation.concerns: Optical-disc aging and surface damage remain the principal risks. The disc is stored upright in its original case under stable, dry conditions; printed materials and any accompanying soundtrack CD remain housed with the copy.
preservation.knownRevisions: First issued in Japan as ペルソナ4 on July 10, 2008. The North American Atlus localization followed on December 9, 2008 as Shin Megami Tensei: Persona 4 (SLUS-21782). Later ports and remasters (including Persona 4 Golden) are separate editions and are not this filing.
preservation.availability: The original physical edition is out of print and circulates through the secondary market. Later digital and remaster editions do not replace this North American PlayStation 2 reference copy.
